# CANDIDATE: VWAP_EXTENSION_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates more than 1.5×ATR(20) from the VWAP, it tends to revert to VWAP within the same bar, offering a short‑term mean‑reversion edge. This effect is strongest in low‑to‑moderate volatility (VIX < 20) and non‑trending markets where VWAP acts as a dynamic fair value rather than support/resistance.

## Mechanism

Calculate ATR(20). At bar close, if |close − VWAP| > 1.5×ATR(20) and the bar closes back toward VWAP (i.e., (close − VWAP) × (open − VWAP) < 0), enter at the close: long if close < VWAP, short if close > VWAP. Initial stop is the bar's extreme opposite the entry side. Target is VWAP (chart‑stop) or 1R from entry, whichever is reached first; if price moves beyond VWAP in favor, allow runner to trail 20% of ATR(20). Only trade when VIX < 20 and the EMA ribbon is not fully stacked (avoid strong trend days).

2. **Sample bias:** No historical backtest performed yet; proposal based on theoretical mean‑reversion logic. High overfit risk until Stage‑1 validation.
